summary: A numbered list of 25 reasons grouped into six themed blocks, each with a heading, a big image and cards, plus a sticky chip bar and an FAQ. Needs 20 to 25 short reasons (title plus one sentence) and one image per group.

sections.note: pale ground; title with lead and one filled button left, team photo in a rounded frame right; below it a pill-chip bar to jump to the six groups (trust, security, performance, technology, talent, location)

six group blocks of 600 to 930px: heading with a round icon, then one large rounded image next to a two by two grid of numbered cards (big pale 01.., title, one sentence, small Learn more link); the image alternates left and right; two groups use a wide banner image over a row of three or six cards
centered heading; five full-width rows, the first open with a blue gradient header
consultation form band in the footer area
